title: EA Sports Adds AI John Motson to FC 27
excerpt: Electronic Arts is bringing an AI-generated version of commentator John Motson to the FC 27 video game with family consent.
body_html:
Electronic Arts has announced plans to include an artificial intelligence-generated version of the late commentator John Motson in its video game, FC 27.

According to the details, the digital recreation of the famous commentator is scheduled to appear in the game on 26 November.

The inclusion of the AI-generated voice and persona has been made with the explicit consent of Motson's wife and son.
